positioning.oneLiner: Real-time crowd density mapping, anomaly detection and alerting for venues and transit.
positioning.problem: Crowds become dangerous gradually and then suddenly; control rooms watching camera walls see the build-up too late and cannot tell where density is rising.
differentiators: Density as a live floor-level field (people per square metre), not a count per camera
Anomalies on trajectories: panic, stampede risk, counter-flow, intrusion, abandoned bags
Runs on the operator's own hardware; works without a GPU in simulation for evaluation
Notifications to staff by role and to the public by distance from the incident

offer.name: Detection pipeline
offer.summary: YOLO person detection and DeepSORT tracking per camera; floor projection, speed, heading and dwell per person.

offer.name: Live density and 3D map
offer.summary: Per-floor heatmaps with isolines, zone occupancy against capacity, a 3D facility map with density as terrain.

offer.name: Anomaly detection
offer.summary: Twelve rule-based detectors with sustain timers and cooldowns; evidence snapshots per alert.

offer.name: Notifications
offer.summary: Staff and geofenced public notices over email, SMS, WhatsApp, push and public-address webhooks.

offer.summary: Minute rollups, typical-week occupancy, zone capacity history, alerts per day, system health.

sections.heading: Read the crowd before it moves.
sections.body: Live density on every floor and anomalies flagged the moment cameras see them.

faq.a: No. It detects and tracks bodies to estimate positions and motion. There is no face recognition, and public notices never include images or individual details.
For live cameras, an NVIDIA GPU is recommended for YOLO inference; one mid-range GPU serves several streams. The simulator runs the whole platform without a GPU or cameras.
On your infrastructure: Postgres, Redis and a shared media volume, deployed with Docker Compose or Kubernetes. Raw frames are not stored; snapshots are kept only for alerts.
RTSP, ONVIF, HTTP/MJPEG, USB, webcams and video files. Each camera is placed on the floor plan with its heading, field of view and range.

references.borrow: A data field rendered as the interface itself; motion that reads as weather, not decoration.
Restraint: dark operational surfaces, small mono labels, nothing playful.
Section rhythm and tight, light display type with generous spacing.
